Interface Handler<K,V>

Type Parameters:
K - the key type of the messages it handles
V - the value type of the messages it handles
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface Handler<K,V>
Stateless user logic, a pure function from a delivered message to the emissions it causes.

The runtime invokes it once per message, in causal order, and applies the returned emissions transactionally with the delivery. Return List.of() to emit nothing.

A handler's effects must flow through its return value, not through shared mutable state or external calls (the closed-effects precondition). The causal guarantee is meaningful only for handlers that meet it.

An exception from a handler fails the task. The transaction aborts and the retry redelivers the same message in the same causal order. recovering(Handler, BiFunction) converts that outcome into emissions for handlers whose failures are part of the domain.

    • recovering

      static <K,V> Handler<K,V> recovering(Handler<K,V> handler, BiFunction<Message<K,V>, RuntimeException, List<Emission>> onFailure)
      Decorates a handler so a RuntimeException becomes the emissions onFailure yields for it, instead of failing the task. An Error still propagates.

      The recovery commits exactly once, in the same transaction as the delivery, and is never retried. Wrap only logic whose throws are deterministic in the message. A transient failure caught here routes a good message to the error sink irrevocably, where the undecorated handler's abort-and-retry would have delivered it. Leave transient infrastructure failure to the default.

      Type Parameters:
      K - the key type of the messages it handles
      V - the value type of the messages it handles
      Parameters:
      handler - the handler to decorate
      onFailure - the emissions to apply for a message and the exception it raised, typically routing to a declared error sink
      Returns:
      the decorated handler
